high_is_start.note: Presented as skipping the output's leading-zero scan because `high` already marks the first used digit; it marks one slot before it, so every output gains a leading '1' (and empty input encodes to "1").

masked_lookup.note: Folds the high-bit check into one masked table lookup; bytes >= 0x80 whose low 7 bits are a valid digit (for example UTF-8 continuation bytes of non-ASCII text) are now accepted as digits instead of rejected. Upstream tests only use ASCII.

full_sweep.note: Presented as a branch-predictor-friendly loop condition; sweeps the whole output buffer for every input byte instead of stopping at the highest used digit. Output is identical, encode does more work.
